# LeakSanitizer suppressions for the sanitizer entry of the CI smoke job.
#
# SDL loads libX11 with dlopen when the video subsystem starts and unloads it
# again in SDL_QuitSubSystem. libX11 keeps process-lifetime state that only
# its own globals point at, so once the library is unmapped, LeakSanitizer
# finds those blocks unreachable at exit and reports them. The allocating
# frames sit inside the unloaded library and print as <unknown module>, so
# each entry names the SDL X11-backend function that made the libX11 call.

# XSetLocaleModifiers and XOpenIM: the locale modifiers and the input-method
# state set up for text input while the keyboard is initialised.
leak:X11_InitKeyboard

# XrmInitialize: the resource-manager quark tables built while reading the
# Xft.dpi content scale.
leak:GetGlobalContentScale
